# DocSolace

> DocSolace writes and maintains an app's tutorials by actually using the app:
> it drives a real headless browser against a running app, takes the
> screenshots itself, and writes tutorial-style documentation grounded in
> what it actually observed on the page — instead of a person clicking
> through the UI and writing prose that goes stale the moment the UI
> changes. It ships primarily as a Claude Code plugin; its pipeline is also
> a set of plain Node scripts runnable directly, without Claude Code.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention — a
concise, link-based index for LLMs/agents, in place of crawling the full
site. It is hand-maintained; see `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s "Project layout" for
the upkeep note, and `__tests__/llms-txt-sync.test.mjs` for the check that
keeps it from silently going stale.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://esandeepchoudary.github.io/docsolace/docs/overview): What DocSolace is, who it's for, and what its four-stage capture/drift/generate/publish pipeline does.
- [Getting started](https://esandeepchoudary.github.io/docsolace/docs/getting-started): Prerequisites, installing/running as a Claude Code plugin, and running the pipeline directly without Claude Code.
- [Concepts](https://esandeepchoudary.github.io/docsolace/docs/concepts): Core vocabulary — tour, capture/drift/generate, keep-regions, auth profiles and seeds.
- [Configuration](https://esandeepchoudary.github.io/docsolace/docs/configuration): Every environment variable and `docsolace.config.yaml` field this project documents.
- [Troubleshooting](https://esandeepchoudary.github.io/docsolace/docs/troubleshooting): Common install/runtime issues, and keeping the plugin updated.

## Tutorials

- [Login page](https://esandeepchoudary.github.io/docsolace/docs/login): Show what a signed-out user sees before authenticating.
- [Dashboard overview](https://esandeepchoudary.github.io/docsolace/docs/dashboard-overview): Show a new user what the main dashboard displays and how to read it.
- [Export dashboard activity](https://esandeepchoudary.github.io/docsolace/docs/dashboard-export): Show how to export the current activity table as a CSV.

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/esandeepchoudary/docsolace): Source code, issues, and the Claude Code plugin marketplace entry (`claude plugin marketplace add esandeepchoudary/docsolace`).
- [README](https://github.com/esandeepchoudary/docsolace/blob/main/README.md): Quickstart, install, and how the pipeline works.
